repro_scripts.skill_recipe_pixelcmp.py:
# ③' 42 张 skill_* 与生成器 recipe 的逐像素比对（纯 stdlib PNG 解码）
import zlib, struct, pathlib
def dec(p):
    d=pathlib.Path(p).read_bytes(); pos=8; idat=b''
    while pos < len(d):
        ln=struct.unpack('>I',d[pos:pos+4])[0]; t=d[pos+4:pos+8]; b=d[pos+8:pos+8+ln]
        if t==b'IHDR': w,h,bd,ct,_,_,il=struct.unpack('>IIBBBBB',b)
        if t==b'IDAT': idat+=b
        pos+=12+ln
    raw=zlib.decompress(idat); st=w*4; rows=[]; prev=bytearray(st)
    for y in range(h):
        f=raw[y*(st+1)]; line=bytearray(raw[y*(st+1)+1:(y+1)*(st+1)])
        if f==1:
            for i in range(4,st): line[i]=(line[i]+line[i-4])&255
        elif f==2:
            for i in range(st): line[i]=(line[i]+prev[i])&255
        elif f==3:
            for i in range(st):
                a=line[i-4] if i>=4 else 0; line[i]=(line[i]+((a+prev[i])>>1))&255
        elif f==4:
            for i in range(st):
                a=line[i-4] if i>=4 else 0; c=prev[i-4] if i>=4 else 0; bb=prev[i]
                pp=a+bb-c; pa=abs(pp-a); pb=abs(pp-bb); pc=abs(pp-c)
                pr=a if (pa<=pb and pa<=pc) else (bb if pb<=pc else c); line[i]=(line[i]+pr)&255
        rows.append(bytes(line)); prev=line
    return w,h,rows
def recipe(rows,w,h):   # skill_menu_items: resize 36 NEAREST -> crop(2,2,34,34) -> alpha 二值
    out=[]
    for y in range(2,34):
        r=bytearray()
        for x in range(2,34):
            p4=rows[y//2][(x//2)*4:(x//2)*4+4]
            r+=p4[:3]+bytes((255 if p4[3]>=128 else 0,))
        out.append(bytes(r))
    return out
ok=[];bad=[]
for p in sorted(pathlib.Path('assets/originalrpg/textures/item').glob('skill_*.png')):
    name=p.name[len('skill_'):-4]
    g=pathlib.Path(f'assets/betterhud/textures/glyph_skill_{name}.png')
    w,h,rows=dec(g)
    w2,h2,disk=dec(p)
    (ok if disk==recipe(rows,w,h) else bad).append(name)
print("skill total:", len(ok)+len(bad))
print("pixel-identical to recipe:", len(ok))
print("mismatch:", bad)
# 对失配项给出差异像素数与"多出的颜色"
for n in bad:
    w,h,rows=dec(f'assets/betterhud/textures/glyph_skill_{n}.png')
    w2,h2,disk=dec(f'assets/originalrpg/textures/item/skill_{n}.png')
    rec=recipe(rows,w,h)
    diff=sum(1 for y in range(32) for x in range(32) if rec[y][x*4:x*4+4]!=disk[y][x*4:x*4+4])
    extra={disk[y][x*4:x*4+4] for y in range(32) for x in range(32)} - {rec[y][x*4:x*4+4] for y in range(32) for x in range(32)}
    print(f"  {n}: diff_px={diff} extra_colors={sorted(c.hex() for c in extra)}")
